nodes.title: Qwen3.8 27B
nodes.help: The local vision-language model for judge, write and decide nodes (MLX 4-bit).

params.name: precision
params.label: Precision
params.help: Stored 4-bit; nothing is quantized at load.

nodes.title: Ask
nodes.help: Asks the model one question about its takes: temperature 0, thinking off, one more try in the same run when the answer does not match the schema.

params.name: prompt
params.label: Prompt
params.help: The filled template (pipelines writes it). Not scanned for mentions.

params.name: media
params.label: Takes
params.help: Image or video takes, in order; each is sent as a thumbnail (a video as 3 keyframes).

params.name: schema
params.label: Answer schema
params.help: A JSON schema the answer must match; empty = plain text.

nodes.title: Answer
nodes.help: Stores its text as the run's answer: no take. Ask workflows end with it.
